title: Reciprocity
coreMove: Choose the move that teaches the next move to become more cooperative, then update on the response pattern.
sourcePressure: Reciprocity is about actions creating reactions in iterative relationships, with positive first moves and forgiveness bounded by observed returns.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: turning reciprocity into abstract kindness, karma, or unconditional niceness
